title: Palantir deep dive - In-Q-Tel lineage, product lines (Gotham/Foundry/AIP/ImmigrationOS/Maven), government & foreign deployments, DOGE/federal-data-consolidation, the data-fusion web
source: Primary/public record: In-Q-Tel investment history; USASpending/FPDS federal contract records; SEC filings (PLTR); UK NHS Federated Data Platform award (~GBP 330M, 2023); DoD/Army (incl. Project Maven successors), ICE (FALCON/ISAP), HHS (HHS Protect / Tiberius), IRS reporting 2025; company disclosures. Structural overlay only; every edge graded in its note. Deep-webbing block for the Palantir/surveillance epic (#216). More webbing to follow.

edges.notes: In-Q-Tel (CIA venture arm) was an early investor/customer that helped seed Palantir (~2005) and shaped Gotham for the IC (fact).
Thiel co-founded and funded Palantir (2003-04) (fact).
Alex Karp is co-founder and CEO of Palantir (fact).
Gotham - the intelligence/defense data-fusion platform (fact).
Foundry - the commercial/enterprise + government data-integration platform (fact).
AIP - the Artificial Intelligence Platform layer (2023+) wiring LLMs onto Gotham/Foundry (fact).
ICE/HSI used Palantir case-management/analytics (FALCON) and ISAP-adjacent tooling; contracts renewed across administrations (fact).
Army adopted Palantir for intelligence data (won a competition vs the Army's DCGS-A; later Vantage/NGC2 work) (fact).
HHS used Palantir for HHS Protect / Tiberius (COVID data + vaccine allocation, 2020-21) (fact).
2025 reporting: Palantir engaged to help build/integrate IRS data systems (contested-scope; details evolving).
Palantir won the NHS England Federated Data Platform (~GBP 330M, Nov 2023), controversial on patient-data grounds (fact).
NHS England is the UK government health body (fact).
Palantir software reported in use for battlefield/targeting data in Ukraine (fact of deployment; operational specifics contested).
Palantir has participated in DoD/DARPA-adjacent data programs (fact, general).
Palantir's AIP integrates commercial LLMs (e.g., via Azure OpenAI / model partners) into its stack (fact; specific model mix varies).
Palantir announced availability of Anthropic's Claude models within its platform for government/defense customers (2024) (fact).
Thiel's Founders Fund is part of the founding/early-capital network around Palantir (fact of network; treat as affiliation, not a live financial edge here).

ImmigrationOS - deportation 'operating system' for ICE: identify/apprehend removal targets, track self-deportations in near-real-time, optimize removal logistics. $30M sole-source prototype (Apr 2025, due Sept 25 2025) extending a 2022 O&M contract (DHS first contracted Palantir for case management in 2014); +$30M Sept 2025 for 'assisted voluntary return', part of a deal worth up to $157.5M. Justified under EO 14159 + EO 13773 (fact).
edges.source: American Immigration Council; Forbes 2025-09-30; The Register 2025-04-21

edges.notes: Deployed for ICE enforcement/deportation operations (fact of deployment; civil-liberties impact contested).

Maven Smart System (MSS) - Palantir's AI targeting/data-fusion successor to Project Maven (DoD, 2017). May 2024 $480M Army prototype; expanded to a ~$1.3B ceiling through 2029 (May 2025 +$795M modification to W911QX-24-D-0012). NGA reported 20,000+ active users across 35+ tools, user base >2x since Jan 2025 (fact).
Contracted via Army Contracting Command (Aberdeen); fielded across Army/Air Force/Space Force/Navy/Marines and combatant commands (fact).

Fannie Mae 'Crime Detection Unit' - Foundry AI to flag mortgage-fraud patterns before loans reach Fannie, starting with multifamily (announced May 28 2025). FHFA Dir. Pulte floated extending to Freddie Mac + talks with xAI (fact of partnership; efficacy TBD).

Under EO of Mar 20 2025 ('Stopping Waste, Fraud, and Abuse by Eliminating Information Silos'), Foundry expanded across >=4 agencies (incl. DHS, HHS); NYT reported >$113M federal funding since Jan 2025 and talks re cross-agency data linkage. FACT: the EO + Foundry expansion. CONTESTED: the 'single master database of Americans' framing - Palantir publicly denies it and 13 ex-employees signed a letter of protest; Privacy Act (1974) suits filed.
edges.source: NYT (via Snopes 2025-06-13); Suffolk JHTL 2025-10-07; Palantir rebuttal

edges.notes: Personnel overlap: >=3 DOGE staff are ex-Palantir and 2 more tied to Thiel-backed firms; DOGE reportedly central to Palantir's agency selection (fact of overlap; degree of influence contested; Palantir disputes the strongest DOGE-tie claims).
Strategic partnership announced Jan 2024 to supply technology 'crucial for war-related missions' to the Israeli defense establishment (fact of announcement; specific deployments not public).
Foundry powered HHS Protect and the CDC/Operation Warp Speed 'Tiberius' vaccine-allocation platform (2020) (fact).

NYT reported Palantir in talks with the Social Security Administration (and IRS) to extend Foundry as the federal role expanded in 2025 (grade: reported/CONTESTED - talks, not a confirmed production deployment).
NATO acquired Palantir's Maven Smart System (2025) - the alliance's AI-enabled targeting/decision backbone; first major NATO enterprise AI buy (fact).
MSS deployed into NATO command - extends the US Army Maven lineage to the alliance (fact).
Foundry used at CMS (Medicare/Medicaid) for data integration/fraud analytics - Palantir across the health-payer core of the federal government (fact of deployment; scope graded).
CMS is the HHS component running Medicare/Medicaid - parent linkage (fact).
Palantir contracts across DHS (parent of ICE/CBP) - targeting, case management, immigration analytics (fact).
ICE is a DHS component - parent linkage that anchors the ImmigrationOS/Gotham deployments (fact).
CBP uses Palantir analytics for border/targeting workflows - the customs-and-border arm of the DHS deployment (fact of use; scope graded).
Palantir won the NHS England Federated Data Platform (~GBP 330M, 2023) - the FDP is Foundry-based (fact).
The FDP unifies NHS trust data nationally - the marquee foreign health-data deployment; privacy-contested (fact of award; concerns graded).

2025: the administration tapped Palantir to help remove 'data silos' across agencies (EO Mar-2025; NYT reporting) - integrating IRS/SSA/immigration data. Palantir DENIES building a central master database; critics warn of a searchable whole-of-government profile of Americans (fact of contracts/EO + reporting; 'master surveillance database' framing = contested interpretation).
IRS is a named node in the cross-agency data-integration push (a mega-API/data project reported 2025) (fact of project; scope contested).
SSA data among the sets targeted for cross-agency integration (fact of reporting; contested).
Immigration enforcement is a primary consumer of unified cross-agency data (ties to ImmigrationOS) (fact/interpretation).

The civil-liberties crux: linking agency datasets into a queryable whole raises the specter of a de-facto national profile - stated as a governance RISK, grounded in the reporting + EO, not a proven system (interpretation).
AIP + 'AIP Bootcamps' drove Palantir's US COMMERCIAL surge (the fastest-growing segment) - the private-sector revenue engine beneath the government story (fact).
2025: a ~$10B Army enterprise software agreement consolidating dozens of contracts under Palantir - a landmark scale-up of the Army relationship (fact).
Palantir is prime on the Army's TITAN (Tactical Intelligence Targeting Access Node) ground station - sensor-to-shooter data fusion (fact).
TITAN delivers deep-sensing/targeting to the Army - hardware+software at the tactical edge (fact).
